## Constants

- `BROWSER_CHECKOUT_DISPATCH_RECEIPT_FORMAT` — Trusted integration boundary for local credentials and consequential actions. The page bridge can request only status or one exact actuation. It never supplies operatorScopeHash, bridgeSessionId, selectors, credential plaintext, enrollment authority, or budget issuance/revocation authority.
